OIL FIELD RATES
STANDARD RATE
For individual oil and gas production and in-field oil pumping and processing services served through SaskPower-supplied transformation - up to and including 3000 kilovolt
amperes (kVA).
Note: General service rates apply to individually metered pumping or compression
services moving pipeline quality oil and gas from the batteries (or gas equivalent) up
to and including refineries and gas plants. Rate Code* E43
Effective February 1, 2026
Basic monthly charge per metering point $81.63
Demand Charge Per kVA of billing demand each month $18.490
Energy Charge ¢/kWh 7.451¢
MINIMUM BILL
The basic monthly charge plus the demand charge. LOADS OVER 3,000 KVA
For loads over 3,000 kVA refer to Oil Field - 25kV/72kV/100kV & Above Rates.
BILLING DEMAND
The maximum kVA demand registered in the applicable billing period but will not be less than 60 per cent of the maximum demand registered in the preceding 11 months.

OIL FIELD RATES
STANDARD RATE
For individual oil and gas production and in-field oil pumping and processing services served through customer-owned transformation - up to and including 3000 kilovolt
amperes (kVA).
Note: General service rates apply to individually metered pumping or compression
services moving pipeline quality oil and gas from the batteries (or gas equivalent) up
to and including refineries and gas plants. Rate Code* E44
Effective February 1, 2026
Basic monthly charge per metering point $81.63
Demand Charge Per kVA of billing demand each month $17.763
Energy Charge ¢/kWh 7.451¢
MINIMUM BILL
The basic monthly charge plus the demand charge. LOADS OVER 3,000 KVA
For loads over 3,000 kVA refer to Oil Field - 25kV/72kV/100kV & Above Rates.
BILLING DEMAND
The maximum kVA demand registered in the applicable billing period but will not be less than 60 per cent of the maximum demand registered in the preceding 11 months.

OIL FIELD RATES 25KV/72KV/100KV & ABOVE TIME-OF-USE RATE
For individual oil and gas production and in-field oil pumping and processing services
served through customer-owned transformation as an alternative to Oil Field - Standard Rates and Oil Field - 25kV/72kV/100kV & Above Rates.
Note: General service rates will apply to individually metered pumping or compression
services moving pipeline quality oil and gas from the batteries (or gas equivalent) up
to and including refineries and gas plants. Rate Codes* E86 E87 E88
Effective February 1, 2026
Supply voltage 25kV 72kV 100kV & above
Basic monthly charge $7,022.82 $8,151.50 $8,731.50
Demand Charge Per kVA of billing demand each month $18.700 $15.203 $12.038
Energy Charge On-peak energy charge (¢/kWh) 7.070¢ 7.023¢ 6.833¢
Off-peak energy charge (¢/kWh) 6.070¢ 6.023¢ 5.833¢
MINIMUM BILL
The basic monthly charge plus the demand charge.
BILLING DEMAND
The monthly billing demand is the monthly recorded demand, but the billing demand should not be less than 75 per cent of the maximum billing demand in the preceding 11
months.
RECORDED DEMAND
The monthly recorded demand is the maximum kVA demand registered during the
current month.

OIL FIELD RATES
ON-PEAK ENERGY CONSUMPTION The monthly energy consumed between the hours of 7:00 to 22:00, Monday through
Friday, excluding statutory holidays.
OFF-PEAK ENERGY CONSUMPTION
The monthly energy consumed in all hours except for the on-peak hours.
AVAILABILITY
These time-of-use rates are optional - at the customer's request. Once a customer
requests to change to these rates they must stay on for at least one year.

OIL FIELD RATES 25KV/72KV/100KV & ABOVE RATE
For individual oil and gas production and in-field oil pumping and processing services
served through customer-owned transformation as an alternative to Oil Field -
Standard Rates.
Note: General service rates will apply to individually metered pumping or compression
services moving pipeline quality oil and gas from the batteries (or gas equivalent) up
to and including refineries and gas plants. Rate Codes* E46 E47 E48
Effective February 1, 2026
Supply voltage 25kV 72kV 100kV & Above
Basic monthly charge $7,022.82 $8,151.50 $8,731.50
Demand Charge Per kVA of billing demand each month $18.700 $15.203 $12.038
Energy Charge ¢/kWh 6.497¢ 6.450¢ 6.260¢
MINIMUM BILL
The basic monthly charge plus the demand charge.
BILLING DEMAND
The monthly billing demand is the monthly recorded demand, but the billing demand will not be less than 75 per cent of the maximum billing demand in the preceding 11
months.
RECORDED DEMAND
The monthly recorded demand is the maximum kilovolt ampere (kVA) demand
registered during the current month.
